document.name: Play La La Open Play
document.address: 4220 Arthur Kill Rd, Staten Island, NY 10309
document.shortDescription: Play La La publishes weekday open play on Staten Island for ages 4 months to 8 years, with Monday-Friday hours on its official site.
document.longDescription:
Play La La's official classes page includes an Open Play section for ages 4 months to 8 years and invites families to join during the venue's open-play hours for full access to the space. The official homepage and classes page both show the Staten Island address and venue hours.

The cited official pages publish venue hours as Monday-Friday from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. and Saturday-Sunday as private parties. Because this listing is specifically for open play, only the weekday open-play hours are used for tags here; the weekend private-party hours are not treated as weekend open-play availability.

The official site lists Play La La at 4220 Arthur Kill Rd, Staten Island, NY 10309. The reviewed pages did not publish a public drop-in admission price, so pricing is stored as unknown.

Sources: https://playlalasi.com/ https://playlalasi.com/classes/ https://playlalasi.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/IMG_7849-1.jpeg
